messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Paging: High error rate observed on the text-generation endpoint (us-west-2). Slowness and 5xxs. Root thread https://incidents/1845001234
Alyssa (on-call SRE): I'm on it. pulling up dashboards now. seeing elevated tail latency and 502s from our model router.
Sanjay (infra): reassigning a node group, possibly flapping gRPC connections to model workers. creating a canary
Alyssa (on-call SRE): ok. temp mitigation: scale down batching to reduce tail latency. applying policy now.
Deploy Bot: autoscaler executed: decreased batch window to 50ms for svc/text-gen in prod.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): watching metrics — latency improving but errors persist for requests with long contexts.
Matt P. (product): any customer-facing impact? we need to decide status page wording and whether to DM top customers.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): impact: ~4% of requests returned 5xx in last 10m, correlated to seq_len > 2048 and quantized model variant. regional: us-west-2 only. Mitigation in progress.
Jordan (Comms): ok — draft status page and short customer note. want to sync on tone: transparent, non-alarming, operational guidance.
Emily (Marketing): we should coordinate any outbound social language with legal. short ack on twitter if warranted, promise updates.
Rosa (Legal): available for quick review. prefer avoid specifics about internal root cause until confirmed.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): proposed status page snippet:
```
Status: Degraded performance for text-generation in US-West-2
Summary: Some customers in US-West-2 may experience increased latency and intermittent errors for long-context requests. Our engineers are actively mitigating; a workaround is to reduce sequence length or switch to fallback model variant.
Impact: ~4% of requests (long-context) affected. Users in other regions unaffected.
ETA: Engineers continue to investigate. Next update in 30 minutes.
```
Jordan (Comms): that reads fine. remove the 4% from public if legal prefers vaguer language?
Rosa (Legal): prefer "a subset of requests" rather than percentage. ok to mention region and workaround.
Jordan (Comms): updated draft:
```
Status: Degraded performance for text-generation (US-West-2)
Summary: A subset of long-context requests may see increased latency and intermittent errors. Engineers are actively investigating. Suggested workaround: reduce sequence length or use the fallback model variant.
Impact: A subset of requests in US-West-2. Other regions unaffected.
Next update: in 30 minutes.
```
Matt P. (product): good. also need a short customer DM for our top 10 customers in the affected region. Suggest: acknowledge, workaround, point to support + dedicated Slack channel.
Jordan (Comms): draft DM:
```
Hi <Customer>,
We're experiencing degraded performance for some long-context requests in US-West-2. We're actively mitigating and recommend reducing sequence length or switching to the fallback model for now. Our SRE team is available in #support-<cust> and we'll share updates via the status page: https://status.redwood.ai
Apologies for the disruption — we're prioritizing this.
```
Emily (Marketing): for Twitter, very short and non-technical. proposed tweet:
"We're aware of degraded generation performance in US-West. Engineers are on it — status updates at https://status.redwood.ai"
Jordan (Comms): add: don't promise ETA. include status link. Rosa ok?
Rosa (Legal): fine.
Sanjay (infra): root cause hypothesis: gRPC connection churn due to kernel-side recycle on a small subset of GPU nodes after recent driver patch. rolling back patch on one node group now.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): rollback initiated. monitoring error rate.
Deploy Bot: rolling update: reverted driver patch on node-group-5.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): errors dropped to 0.8% within 6min of rollback. latency normalizing. great.
Matt P. (product): recommend updating status page to "Investigating -> Identified -> Mitigated" timeline. Jordan can you push the transition copy?
Jordan (Comms): timeline update draft:
```
Status: Resolved (US-West-2)
Summary: The issue was linked to a recent GPU driver patch leading to connection instability on a subset of nodes. A rollback was performed and service returned to normal. Affected traffic is now back to baseline.
Impact: A subset of long-context requests in US-West-2 experienced transient errors. No customer data impact.
Follow-up: Postmortem and remediation plan will be shared within 72 hours.
```
Rosa (Legal): remove the definitive root-cause phrasing until postmortem confirms. change "was caused by" -> "linked to".
Jordan (Comms): updated.
Jordan (Comms): final note for social/blog: we should not post a technical blog immediately. if we do a blog it should be a measured postmortem summarizing impact, timelines, and actions. for now, tweet + status page + customer DMs.
Emily (Marketing): agree. i'll queue the tweet and coordinate timing with Jordan.
Matt P. (product): who signs off on the customer DM list? Customer Success + Support?
Jordan (Comms): pinging @Emily (Marketing) and @Rosa for final signoff on message copy. also need confirmation that status page is updated before any outbound.
Emily (Marketing): signoff on tweet copy. will not publish until status page shows "Resolved" -> we may publish an interim "we're investigating" tweet if status page is live.
Rosa (Legal): signoff on wording.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): closing the incident thread for paging — SRE will post a short postmortem draft in #postmortems. I'll add timeline + remediation.
Matt P. (product): thanks all. quick action coordination was great. can we add a checklist to the incident runbook: include explicit "do not post root-cause until postmortem" and customer DM approval steps.
Jordan (Comms): noted. will add to comms runbook and reference in postmortem.
Incident Bot: incident 1845001234 status updated -> Resolved. Postmortem required.
Alyssa (on-call SRE): copying final artifacts: status page update URL: https://status.redwood.ai/1845001234, DM template posted to #support-templates, postmortem draft assigned to Alyssa.
Jordan (Comms): closing loop: Emily will hold tweet draft until postmortem link is live. thanks everyone.
